files.README.md:
# Sablewood Furniture - product care guide

Customer-care reference guide. The guide is organised into files and appendices, and the list in guide/index.txt is authoritative. Cross-references always cite the appendix letter and the cited appendix must exist.
files.guide/care-oak.md:
# Oak furniture care

## Cleaning

Wipe with a barely damp cloth; never use silicone polishes on oak.

## Oil finish

Re-oil oiled oak every 12 months with the supplied oil.
files.guide/upholstery.md:
# Upholstery care

## Routine care

Vacuum weekly with the brush head and rotate the cushions monthly.

## Stains

Stain removal codes for the performance fabrics are set out in Appendix B, 'Performance fabric stain codes'.
